status: declared by the pull request that closes #484 before any score was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing here is published, no published figure moves, no 2026 day is read. The back-filled history is used as training history only, under the guard of repo_model.backfill (#430, ruling of 8 October 2026 on #374).

scoring.note: the scoring declaration of metadata/risk_date_severity.json, unchanged: scripts/risk_date_severity.py run through scripts/backfill_history.py run, which raises minimum_history by the number of back-filled rows so the first scored origin, every refit block and every scored day are the ones the script scores without the history

arms.without: scripts/risk_date_severity.py run on the published days' panel with the measurement columns (pressure_v1_1.py panel, then measurement_fields.py panel); the control, through backfill_history.py run --control so the same recorders read it
arms.with: the same script, unchanged, through backfill_history.py run on the extended panel (backfill_history.py panel, then backfill_history.py augment): the same rows from 2018-04-03 and 899 back-filled rows before them; the with-history forecasts are named <model>+history (metadata/pressure_judge/candidates/<model>+history.json)

missing_inputs_before_2018.rule: no fill. A back-filled row whose read of any declared input is blank trains no pair (ml._pressure_pairs: 'a direct pressure model is not fitted on an unobserved input'); the row is dropped from that model's training, as a blank is dropped in the published rows. The run records, per model, the back-filled label days that did train a pair (the recorder of backfill_history.py run --pairs-output).

inputs_with_no_back_filled_value.tga_daily: the daily TGA snapshot of measurement_fields starts on the first published day

missing_inputs_before_2018.so: risk_gbm and risk_logistic read these four, so they train no pair on a back-filled row and are expected to score exactly as without the history (reported as measured); risk_gbm_base, risk_logistic_base and risk_quantile_skewt_base read none of them and use the back-filled risk-date label days whose other reads exist

reading.judge_row: scripts/backfill_history.py judge: tiers 1, 3 and 5 under the rule in force (metadata/pressure_judge.json, metadata/weighted_miss.json), with and without the history, paired, with the judge's stationary-bootstrap intervals
reading.by_year: onset recall by calendar year of the onset, 2018, 2020 and 2024 called out; false alarms per onset by calendar year, flat and under the weighted miss rule, at the worst horizon of the +5 bp onset tier
reading.training_history: for each 2018 onset, the refit in force at h = 1 and h = 5: the training window, the pressure days and onsets it holds (setup_diagnostic.training_counts), with and without the back-fill, and the pressure days on risk dates (what a risk-date model trains on)
reading.rows_used: per model, the back-filled rows that trained a pair in the last fit

pairing: with against without, same scored days, same cut-off rule; the intervals are the judge's (stationary bootstrap, 90%)
